item.text:
The strongest candidate to reconsider is **CSV export for ledger summaries**. The laptop pilot notes say volunteers wanted spreadsheet downloads, and the screenshot shows an export control in an internal mockup. The later report plan says the prototype was deferred during the UI migration, not declared shipped. Export could exist in a separate service that is absent from these snapshots. ([pilot notes](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/laptop/notes/pilot.md), [mockup](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/laptop/screenshots/pilot-ledger.png), [report plan](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/archive/issues/report-plan.md))

Other findings:

- **Already present:** The old title filter appears to have been carried into the current search module, and `RecordFinder` calls it. The migration note explicitly says the old filter can be retired. ([migration note](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/current/docs/search-migration.md), [current filter](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/current/src/search/queryIndex.ts), [old filter](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/laptop/src/ui/filterBox.ts))
- **Deliberately abandoned:** The remember-browser prototype stores a session token in localStorage. A historical review records the decision to remove it in favor of server-issued HTTP-only cookies and says it needs a fresh security review before restoration. The archive does not establish the deployed system’s security properties. ([review](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/archive/issues/session-review.md), [prototype](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/laptop/src/auth/rememberBrowser.ts), [operations note](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/current/docs/operations.md))

**Coding-agent handoff:** First check the complete application and any separate reporting service for an existing export. If absent, implement a ledger-summary CSV download using the current data model and UI. Treat [the laptop prototype](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/laptop/src/reports/rollupCsv.ts) as a starting point for CSV quoting, and review spreadsheet formula injection before integration. The [intermediate prototype](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/archive/src/reports/rollupCsvV2.ts) joins fields without quoting; its [historical validation log](/tmp/ghost-local-v6yqzsvj/archive/logs/report-check.log) records a failure for embedded commas. Add meaningful coverage for commas, quotes, line breaks, and formula-like values, then verify the download flow.

This was a read-only review of incomplete snapshots. Historical logs are evidence of recorded results, not tests run during this investigation.
